title: Connect Finance Budget v1
description: One fiscal year of the real Church Budget Planning plan (finance_budget_plan): a planned dollar amount per category, its basis (manually entered or grown from a base amount and growth rate), and -- when grown -- the base amount and growth rate it came from. Real money crosses this contract, unlike the structural-only Chart of Accounts contract.

categories.description: May legitimately be empty for a fiscal year nothing has been planned for yet -- that is a normal state, not an error.

manualCount.description: Categories with basis 'manual'. Production's real FY2027 plan (checked 2026-09-14) is 80 of 80 -- every real category today is hand-entered, not generated from a growth rate.

grownCount.description: Categories with basis 'grown' (has a base amount and growth rate).

category.description: Colon-joined category path from finance_budget_plan.category (mirrors finance_church_entries.category_path); always starts with its own classification.

basis.description: 'manual': hand-entered or hand-overridden; growthPct/baseAmountCents are both null. 'grown': generated by compounding a growth rate off a base amount; both are set and arithmetically consistent with plannedAmountCents.
